arcades.info_text: To get to Lotte World find your way to Jamsil Station on Line 2 or 8. Follow the many signs to the park. Admission is cheaper with a Shinhan bank card. / Lotte World is a huge Korean theme park, perhaps the best. It is a knock off of the Disney Parks but it is pretty cool on its own merit. It is the world's largest indoor theme park (and it is indeed impressive). There are a ton of good rides here, Atlantis Adventure, Cosmic Express, Pharoah's Fury and Gyro Swing were my favorites. / The arcade locations are all located in the indoor park. The is one arcade, the Moroccan arcade, with a lot of fighting games (Tekken 6 etc.) The arcade with rhythm games was located next to the "Happy Tree Picnic" ride, and "Marion Crepes". It is on the first floor. There is another arcade on floor three by the big loop of "French Revolution" with nothing of interest. There is one more arcade connected to the Folk Museum apparently, but I did not have a chance to explore. / Overall it's a great park, I expected a lot more rhythm games though. Maybe they are hidden somewhere...
